definitions.gloss: entrance; entryway (esp. a school's, where shoes are changed)
definitions.explanation: The entrance area of a building—typically a school—where people go in and out and often change between outdoor shoes and indoor shoes. Also a boarding hatch on a ship or aircraft.

examples.japanese: {昇降口|しょうこうぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}き{替|か}える→履き替える：06680_hakikaeru⟧。
examples.english: To change your shoes at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{昇降口|しょうこうぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まっている→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: The students are gathering at the entrance.

examples.japanese: {昇降口|しょうこうぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下駄箱|げたばこ}→下駄箱：06490_getabako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上履|うわば}き→上履き：10240_uwabaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧しまった。
examples.english: I put my indoor shoes away in the shoe locker at the entrance.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{昇降|しょうこう}→昇降：15147_shoukou⟧ (going up and down, entering and exiting) + {口|ぐち} (opening, gate). In everyday Japanese it most often means the shoe-changing entrance of a school.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昇降口|しょうこうぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下駄箱|げたばこ}→下駄箱：06490_getabako⟧: the shoe lockers at the entrance
- {昇降口|しょうこうぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせる→待ち合わせる：12328_machiawaseru⟧: to meet up at the entrance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧: entryway — of a home or building generally
- {出入口|でいりぐち}: entrance/exit — a plain word for any doorway
